name: Exact bead energy-density to Time-Shell metric-scale constitutive relation

metadata.title: Exact bead energy-density to Time-Shell metric-scale constitutive relation
metadata.text:
Each bead $i$ carries log-energy $m_i = \ln(\mu_i/\mu_0)$, metric log-scale 
$\varphi_i = \tfrac{1}{2}\ln(\det g^{(i)}_{ab})$, time phase $\theta_i$, and 
adjacency edges $b_{ij}$ defining local geometry.

\section{Time-Shell Geometry}
The time shell is the 2D hypersurface of the present moment. Its induced metric:
\[
h_{ab} = \partial_a X^\mu \partial_b X^\nu g_{\mu\nu},
\]
determines spacetime curvature. The constitutive relation linking energy density 
and geometric scale is:
\[
\varphi + \alpha m = \varphi_0.
\]
